summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of handling binary strings for the HTTP method, but it may introduce behavioral regressions.

issues.description: The patch changes the method conversion from `builtin_str` to `to_native_string`, which might affect other parts of the codebase that rely on the current behavior. This could lead to unexpected behavior or regressions.
There are no additional tests provided to ensure that the change does not introduce new issues or regressions. It is crucial to have comprehensive tests covering various input types and scenarios.
